previous_statement: Involution and C*-norm obligation. At every amplification, the inherited dagger is isometric. For A,B in the square corner, lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities and the ambient anti-multiplicativity give (A dot B)^dagger=Co_{P_n}((AB)^dagger)=Co_{P_n}(B^dagger A^dagger)=B^dagger dot A^dagger. Moreover lem-compcb-rectangular-product and the ambient lower C*-estimate give ||A^dagger dot A||>=||A^dagger A||-C_r*e||A||^2>=(1-epsilon-C_r*e)||A||^2>=(1-K_p*e)||A||^2. Hence the involution and C*-norm axioms hold with error at most C_ca*e.
new_statement: Involution and C*-norm obligation. Let C_r,e_r be witnesses from lem-compcb-rectangular-product and set K_p=C_r+1. At every amplification and for e<=e_r, if A is in S_{P_n}, then A=Co_{P_n}(A); lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities therefore gives A^dagger=Co_{P_n}(A^dagger), so the inherited isometric dagger preserves the corner. For A,B in that corner, the same external and ambient anti-multiplicativity give (A dot B)^dagger=Co_{P_n}((AB)^dagger)=Co_{P_n}(B^dagger A^dagger)=B^dagger dot A^dagger. Finally lem-compcb-rectangular-product and the ambient lower C*-estimate give ||A^dagger dot A||>=||A^dagger A||-C_r*e||A||^2>=(1-epsilon-C_r*e)||A||^2>=(1-K_p*e)||A||^2. Thus the involution and lower C*-norm axioms hold uniformly at every matrix level.
